mapper.sql: bool_delete_enum, create_time, update_time, version, id, product_id, project_id, quantity, user_id
mapper.select: SELECT link.id, machine_part.id product_id, machine_part.`name`, machine_part.project_id 'project.id', project.`name` 'project.name', project.`short_name` 'project.short_name', project.`serial_number` 'project.serial_number', machine_part.monomer_id 'monomer.id', monomer.`name` 'monomer.name', machine_part.area_id 'area.id', area.`name` 'area.name', machine_part.specification, machine_part.serial_number, machine_part.net_weight, machine_part.gross_weight, machine_part.length, machine_part.material, machine_part.thick thick, link.quantity, sch.thick schThick , sch.material schMaterial, link.quantity * machine_part.net_weight total_net_weight, link.quantity * machine_part.gross_weight total_gross_weight FROM mes_building_machine_part_scheduling_link link LEFT JOIN mes_building_machine_part_scheduling sch ON sch.id=scheduling_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part machine_part ON machine_part.id=link.product_id LEFT JOIN contract_project project ON machine_part.project_id=project.id LEFT JOIN plan_monomer monomer ON machine_part.monomer_id=monomer.id LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON machine_part.area_id=area.id WHERE link.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND scheduling_id = #{id}
